# Impeccable — Design Director Skill for Muse

A design-director skill with a full command system: build commands (`shape`, `init`, `document`, `extract`), evaluate commands (`critique` with heuristic scoring, `audit` for a11y/perf/responsive), refine commands (`polish`, `bolder`, `quieter`, `distill`, `harden`, `onboard`), enhance commands (`animate`, `colorize`, `typeset`, `layout`, `delight`, `overdrive`, `clarify`, `adapt`, `optimize`), and live browser iteration (`live`, `generate`). It runs through a self-contained launcher binary, loads PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md context, and works in bounded verification passes (build fully, inspect once, fix in one batch, stop). Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the launcher downloads a self-contained binary on first run — inspect it yourself; and it ships with hooks/doctor commands that modify project configuration, so only run it on projects you own. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
